description: Pinned MiniMax-H3 Comfy custom_nodes for Gemmy Comfy backend. SHAs from install-time clones; doctor verifies presence.

pins.name: ComfyUI-sol-attn
pins.role: Saganaki Sol-Attn + H3 fused mod / chunk FF

pins.name: ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3
pins.role: Spectrum feature forecasting for native H3

pins.name: ComfyUI-NVIDIA-RTX-VSR-Pro
pins.role: Product video upscale: RTXVideoSuperResolution via gemmy video h3 upscale --backend rtx (requires optional nvidia-vfx)

pins.name: gemmy-h3-context
pins.role: Required Gemmy AV persist + masked_av / VAE-tail / trim-prefix / Split+Join nodes. Not a third-party clone.

pins.name: ComfyUI-Ref2VA-VSA
pins.role: Opt-in Ref2VA Visual Sparse Attention (Ref2VAVSAGatePatch). Needs comfy-kitchen>=0.2.33 sol_attn. Mutex with --sol / --cache.

pins.name: ComfyUI-PixelForge-H3
pins.role: Product sprites: H3 clip → chroma key → quantize → crop/loop/sheet/GIF. gemmy video h3 sprites. MIT.

pins.name: ComfyUI-NVIDIA-DLSS-Frame-Interpolation
pins.role: Product frame interpolation post: gemmy video h3 interpolate. MIT node code. NVIDIA DLSS SDK DLLs are local Git LFS (not committed). Interpolation only — VSR-Pro stays the upscale path.

pins.name: ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3Mod
pins.role: Product RefMods: create/load/apply/text-encode reusable H3 VAE latents. gemmy video h3 refmod + generate --ref-mod. MIT. No extra weights. H3RefModPicker is not pinned (Comfy canvas).

optional_pins.name: Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler
optional_pins.role: Optional 3D latent spatial SR for gemmy video h3 upscale --backend latent. Node repo has no LICENSE; weights are Apache-2.0 (HF LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler). Doctor-notes only.

optional_pins.name: ComfyUI-H3-FaceRefine
optional_pins.role: Optional MIT FaceRefine post for gemmy video h3 face-refine. Detector face_yolov8m.pt (Bingsu/adetailer). Doctor-notes only.

optional_pins.name: ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context
optional_pins.role: Optional GPL-3.0 local clone for continuous FL2VA speech (MiniMaxH3MotionContext / Trim). Product Comfy is 0.36.0 — v0.6.2 is possible later, not this pass. Not video continue/loop (that stays gemmy-h3-context). Gitignored; doctor-notes only. Next-look tag: v0.6.2 @ 5335715abe54c1a9bfbe3494da29aae3e8635ce3.

optional_pins.name: ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-009jev
optional_pins.role: Optional GPL-3.0 009jev slice only (H3JevNativeSLAPatch). gemmy video h3 generate --jev. Not W4A4 convert / H3V2JevAdaptiveVSAPatch. Not a default doctor-required pin. Dedicated SDK: runtimes/minimax-h3/jev-sdk (typesafe-sdk==0.7.0).

ema_wan.note: WanGP/DeepBeepMeep lab fallback; hardlink OK; not product default

realism_people.note: Style LoRA after turbo; T2V/I2V/R2V; card lighter band 0.6–0.8

vsa_gate.note: External FastH3 VSA gate transplant for --vsa. Not a LoRA. Required when --vsa is set.
